core.title: 5 Inch Forged Iron Square Bolt, Acorn ALBBP

text.description_html:
Acorn ALBBP, 5" Iron Square Bolt

The 5 Inch Forged Iron Square Bolt is great for anywhere you would like to add a bit of rustic charm; the rough black iron finish mimics the texture of naturally weathered iron and carries a lifetime no rust warranty making it perfect for interior as well as exterior use. Comes packaged with surface, rim, and mortise strikes so it will easily fit almost any application. There is something undeniably old world about a slide bolt that brings to mind rustic settings and big wooden doors.

Also Available Matching:
3-1/4 Inch Forged Iron Square Bolt,
6-7/8 Forged Iron Square Bolt,

Features and Specifications of the Forged Iron Square Bolt:

  • Material: Iron
  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Bolt Length: 5"
  • Back Plate Length: 4"
  • Back Plate Width: 1-1/2"
  • Comes packaged with three strikes: surface, rim, and mortise.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
